items.t: Microsoft's latest outage hit Outlook and Copilot — what it means for your email
items.sum: No one has confirmed what caused the Microsoft outage that took down Outlook and Copilot, and nothing links it to layoffs or AI, but it's not the first time Microsoft's own changes broke its apps.

items.t: Cerebras Stocks Jump 11.70% After Raising Outlook and Confirming Microsoft Cloud Deal
items.sum: The AI chipmaker lifted 2026 core revenue guidance to as much as $960 million and reported a $26.1 billion backlog.

items.t: CBRG 2X Cerebras ETF Surges 16% as Cerebras Jumps 8% on Microsoft Deal and Raised Guidance
items.sum: A leveraged Cerebras fund that lost more than half its value in a month is suddenly ripping higher while NVIDIA and AMD sink. A new hyperscaler customer explains the move, but one unresolved OpenAI problem could still turn it ugly.
